name: Freezing Floor Tiles

stealth.details: +23 (expert) or DC 38 Perception check (master) to notice the four sensors

disable: DC 40 Thievery check (legendary) or Dispel Magic (6th rank; counteract DC 38) to disable one of the sensors
routine: (4 actions) The trap loses 1 action per disabled sensor. On each action, the trap causes a random 10-foot-by-10-foot space in the arena to suddenly freeze. Each creature that begins its turn in a frozen space takes 2d6+2 cold damage (DC 40 basic Reflex save save). A creature that critically fails its save also becomes Slowed 1 for 1 round; if it was already slowed, the creature instead becomes Immobilized for 1 round. Any amount of fire damage dealt to a slowed or immobilized creature removes the condition. Frozen tiles become unfrozen at the beginning of the trap's next turn.

items.name: Frigid Floor
items.text:
Trigger Hao Jin signals the beginning of the match.

---

Effect The trap rolls initiative.

text: Four remote sensors at each corner of the arena cause bursts of freezing magic to erupt from random tiles on the arena and stop creatures in their tracks.
